title: Clicking the disabled Day box chooses it and empties Days
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type 14 in the Days box.
  3. Click the disabled Day box.
  4. Click the disabled Days box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Days box reads 14.

Step 3:

  • "Due day of the following month" becomes chosen, the cursor is in the Day box, and the Days box is now disabled and empty.

Step 4:

  • "Due Net X days" becomes chosen again, the cursor is in the Days box (empty, the 14 was not kept), and the Day box is disabled and empty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R3: “A new term opens on "Due Net X days" with both boxes empty and the Day box disabled. Only the chosen option's box is active; the other is disabled and empty.”
  • S3-R4: “Clicking the disabled box chooses its option and puts the cursor in it. Switching options empties the box being left, so only the chosen option's number is checked and saved.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("New credit term: Net X days", "New credit term: day of the following month"). The design's own words:

  • “Only the selected option's box is active (Days, with 14). The other option's box is greyed out (DS disabled field) and empty. Clicking a greyed box selects its option; switching clears the box you left.”
  • “Day is active with 10; the Days box is greyed out (disabled) and empty, cleared when the option switched.”
